text: M2增速高于社融、存款增速高于贷款，怎么回事？ 已不能只通过贷款增速或增量来观察金融总量变化，而是要关注广义货币M2、社会融资规模等覆盖更全面的指标。
text_en: M2 growth higher than social financing, deposit growth higher than loans—what's going on? Financial aggregate changes can no longer be observed only through loan growth or increment, but rather through broader indicators like broad money M2 and social financing
